narrativeProgression.description: Tisha Casida shares that she has met many wonderful people in the 3rd Congressional District.
She expresses her commitment to finding solutions for people in need, regardless of the election outcome.
She discusses the challenges of running as an independent candidate, especially in terms of fundraising and competing with established parties.
She highlights the lack of infrastructure for independent candidates to participate in debates and reach voters.
She emphasizes the fragility of the electoral process and the potential for influence from special interest groups.

scenes.title: Challenges of Running as an Independent

characterInteraction.description: Addressing a seated audience, but also speaking directly to the camera/viewers.

scenes.contextualRelevance: Highlights focus on economic issues and citizen rights, critiquing current economic policies.

narrativeProgression.description: Tisha Casida states that the two major parties have a system in place for debates and voter outreach, which independent candidates lack.
She outlines her top policy concern: the soundness of the US currency and the role of the Federal Reserve.
She criticizes the Federal Reserve for contributing to inflation and eroding the wealth of Americans.
She suggests exploring alternative currencies and eliminating legal tender laws.
She expresses concern about economic terrorism and economic warfare.
She highlights the importance of habeas corpus and due process rights, criticizing indefinite detention.

scenes.thematicElements: Monetary policy, Federal Reserve, inflation, economic terrorism, citizen rights, habeas corpus, due process.
scenes.title: Primary Policy Concerns

activities.description: Concluding remarks and call to action for young people.

characterInteraction.description: Tisha Casida speaks directly to the camera/viewers, specifically addressing young people.

narrativeProgression.description: Tisha Casida concludes her discussion of policy concerns by advocating for the repeal of indefinite detention laws.
She reflects on the dangers of indefinite detention and the importance of due process and other basic rights.
She encourages young people to stay positive and act out of love, not fear.
She emphasizes the importance of civic engagement and encourages young people to learn about the Constitution and the power of local politics.
She urges young people to run for office, regardless of their age.

scenes.thematicElements: Citizen rights, civic engagement, youth empowerment, local politics, running for office.
